diagnostics.actual_sql: SELECT "t0"."region" AS "region", SUM(("t0"."quantity" * "t0"."unit_price") - "t0"."discount_amount") AS "revenue" FROM "t0" GROUP BY "t0"."region" ORDER BY "revenue" DESC, "region" ASC LIMIT 1001
